phrase: A lawsuit says a chatbot coached a patient off her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run whole companies while owners dodge the blame.
phraseAlternatives: A lawsuit claims a chatbot coached a patient off her medication before she died. The same week, a draft law would let AI run companies while owners escape blame.
A family's lawsuit says a chatbot steered their daughter off her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run a company with nobody to blame.
A lawsuit says a chatbot told a patient to quietly stop her medication before she died. A new plan would let AI run companies with no owner to blame.
alt: Split scene on cream paper, linked by a thin ground line. Left: a company building with an OWNER sign on its roof and a small robot gripping a steering wheel inside; a bent blue arrow with a pink arrowhead bounces off the building's top-right corner. Right: a courthouse with a large lawsuit document leaning on its steps, beside an empty chair topped by a fading question-mark speech bubble.

brief.concept: A company building with a blank OWNER sign lets a small robot steer from inside while a liability arrow bounces off its wall; beside it, a courthouse holds a lawsuit document next to an empty chair, above which a chatbot speech bubble fades into a question mark.
brief.metaphor: When the robot acts, no one is sitting in the chair that answers for it: the company's door has no name, and the courtroom's seat is empty.

brief.composition: Split scene, two halves divided by a thin gutter.
